newsitem.title: FRANCE: MEPs complete info society copyright consultation.
newsitem.headline: MEPs complete info society copyright consultation.

text.p: The European Parliament adopted a report on Tuesday on Council decisions in relation to the European Convention on copyright law and neighbouring rights for transfrontier satellite broadcasting.

Deputies adopted the report by Spanish Socialist Manuel Medina Ortega on European Commission proposals contained within COM(96)6, which relate to institutional arrangements for signature and approval of decisions related to the Europen Convention.
Parliament's involvement was under the consultation procedure.

The intention of the proposal is to close certain loopholes in copyright protection which are not covered by Directive 93/83/EEC and Directive 92/100/EEC. These relate to the rights of performers, record producers and broadcasters in the case of satellite broadcasts.
